wrappers.name: clothing-new
wrappers.description: Use only when the user explicitly invokes $clothing-new to start a new garment-design project.
wrappers.default_prompt: Use $clothing-new to start a new garment-design project.
gates: Register an attached reference before asking the first question.
Ask exactly one question per response.
scope: Do not create a project from a vague presentation request.

wrappers.name: clothing-resume
wrappers.description: Use only when the user explicitly invokes $clothing-resume to select and continue an existing garment project.
wrappers.starts: Selection and resumption of an existing project
wrappers.default_prompt: Use $clothing-resume to find and continue an existing garment project.
gates: A listed project is not selected until the user confirms it.
Migration apply requires a separate affirmative user reply.
scope: Never search the home directory or unrelated folders.

wrappers.name: clothing-options
wrappers.description: Use only when the user explicitly invokes $clothing-options to create or revise an A/B/C/W garment visual round.
wrappers.default_prompt: Use $clothing-options to create or revise four garment design directions.
gates: Show all four labelled visuals before asking for a choice.
Record the selected look in production-readable words, not as a concept id alone.
scope: A generated preview is never approval or a production master.

wrappers.name: clothing-approve
wrappers.description: Use only when the user explicitly invokes $clothing-approve to review a registered garment concept for possible approval.
wrappers.starts: Review of one registered concept for approval
wrappers.default_prompt: Use $clothing-approve to review a registered garment concept for possible approval.
gates: Invocation text is never the approval statement.
Show the exact candidate and wait for a separate affirmative user reply.
scope: A conditional reply or edit request returns to options instead of approving.

wrappers.name: clothing-production-pack
wrappers.description: Use only when the user explicitly invokes $clothing-production-pack to validate and export a factory handoff for an approved garment design.
wrappers.starts: Validation and export of a factory handoff
wrappers.default_prompt: Use $clothing-production-pack to validate and export a factory handoff.
gates: Validate for export and resolve every blocker before export.
scope: Generated concepts, mockups, cut-outs, try-ons, and listing visuals are never production masters.

wrappers.name: clothing-extract
wrappers.description: Use only when the user explicitly invokes $clothing-extract to make catalogue cut-outs from garment imagery they own or license.
wrappers.starts: Catalogue cut-outs from owned or licensed garment imagery
wrappers.default_prompt: Use $clothing-extract to create catalogue cut-outs from my garment image.
gates: External image transmission requires a separate affirmative consent reply.
Confirm the garment inventory before planning cut-outs.
scope: Produce garment cut-outs rather than OCR or general photo edits.

wrappers.name: clothing-ai-models
wrappers.description: Use only when the user explicitly invokes $clothing-ai-models to create or manage fictional presentation models for their garments.
wrappers.starts: Creation and selection of fictional presentation models
wrappers.default_prompt: Use $clothing-ai-models to create fictional presentation models for my garments.
gates: Keep decisions require the user's own affirmative reply.
scope: Create fictional people only; refuse real people, celebrities, influencers, and lookalikes.

wrappers.name: clothing-try-on
wrappers.description: Use only when the user explicitly invokes $clothing-try-on to put an owned approved design on a fictional presentation model.
wrappers.starts: An approved owned design on a kept fictional model
wrappers.default_prompt: Use $clothing-try-on to place my approved garment design on a fictional model.
gates: Keep decisions require the user's own affirmative reply.
scope: Refuse shopper try-on and third-party branded garments; use approved owned designs and fictional models only.

wrappers.name: clothing-listing-concept
wrappers.description: Use only when the user explicitly invokes $clothing-listing-concept to create a non-live marketplace-style visual for their approved garment.
wrappers.default_prompt: Use $clothing-listing-concept to create a non-live marketplace-style visual for my approved garment.
gates: Keep decisions require the user's own affirmative reply.
scope: Create a labelled non-live concept with no prices, sizes, unconfirmed claims, or publishing.
